race.comment: Tough finish, wide in the quaddie looks the play! SOMEWHERE (8) raced wide without cover on a good tempo last start here behind Perfect Ten who won well again next time out. Does draw wide again here but with a bit of luck can slot in and go close. MUKHTALIF (7) resumes. He won his Australian debut nicely from the front over 1800m then clearly had a problem when last as favourite at Flemington. 1600m is on the lower end of his range and he draws wide but he's one that could go on to better races than this while most have found their level. LOVELYCUT (15) is bursting to win another one, she was no match for Changing Colours last time but that's good form and they gapped third. Some niggle at 1600m but with the right back to follow she'll go close. STAY SILENT (9) has won two on the bounce, ridden aggressively last time and it paid off. He can adopt similar tactics from the wide gate. MAKDANE (5) comes back to a mile but is going well, the 2nd to First Chorus two back reads well.
